summary.en: A robust multilingual speech recognizer trained on 680,000 hours of weakly supervised audio
summary.zh: 使用 68 万小时弱监督音频训练的稳健多语种语音识别系统

description.en:
Whisper reframed speech recognition as a scale-and-diversity problem. OpenAI trained an encoder-decoder Transformer on 680,000 hours of multilingual and multitask audio gathered with weak supervision, avoiding dependence on a narrowly curated benchmark corpus.

The model performs transcription, translation, language identification and timestamp prediction through a shared token interface. Its zero-shot robustness across datasets made a practical case for broad web-scale supervision in speech systems.
description.zh:
Whisper 把语音识别重新表述为规模与数据多样性问题。OpenAI 使用 68 万小时多语种、多任务弱监督音频训练编码器-解码器 Transformer，降低了对狭窄人工整理基准语料的依赖。

模型通过统一的 token 接口完成转写、翻译、语言识别和时间戳预测。它在多个数据集上的零样本稳健性，证明了大规模网络弱监督对实用语音系统的价值。

role.en: First author of the Whisper paper

notes.en: Completed 2022 event research with primary-source verification, localized narrative, portrait decision, original explainer and audience quiz.
notes.zh: 已完成 2022 年事件研究，包括一手资料核验、双语正文、肖像选择结论、原创解释图和观众 quiz。
